title: Carb time alarm in BW not working
symptom: The carb time alarm in BW (Bolus Wizard) is not working for several users. It does not appear to be a permissions issue. Tested on Jelly 2 (Android 10) and Pixel 3a (Android 11).
evidence_quote: This feature does not appear to be working for several users according to Facebook comments. Does not appear to be a permissions issue. I've tried it on both a Jelly 2 (Android 10) and Pixel 3a (Android 11)
